name: Ride to the Undercity
summary: A courier carries Podrig's weapons request from the Sepulcher to the Undercity. A dread bat bears the message over Silverpine Forest to the Forsaken capital.

sections.title: Wings Over Silverpine
sections.body: Karos Razok handles the dread bats at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. They carry messengers and supplies between the Forsaken capital and its frontline outposts. The roads below are dangerous, with hostile beasts, Moonrage worgen, and Scourge remnants. The bats give urgent military requests a swift route to the capital.

sections.title: Arming the Front
sections.body: In the Undercity's Trade Quarter, the courier brings Podrig's equipment request to Gordon Wendham. The weaponsmith prepares arms for the Dark Lady's cause and keeps outposts such as the Sepulcher supplied with battle-ready weapons. Those outposts defend the young Forsaken nation against its surrounding enemies.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this flight to the Undercity?
faq.answer: The flight carries Deathguard Podrig's weapons request from the Sepulcher to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. It also shows new champions how to use the Forsaken flight network.

aliases: who is the sepulcher bat master
faq.answer: Karos Razok handles the dread bats at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. The bats carry Forsaken messengers and supplies to and from the Undercity.
Gordon Wendham is a Forsaken weaponsmith in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, near the bat handler's landing platform. He keeps weapons clean, sharp, and ready for Lady Sylvanas's frontline forces.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken use bats for transit?
faq.answer: The Forsaken use dread bats to travel swiftly above dangerous ground. They cross Lordaeron's blighted skies over threats such as feral worgen, hostile rot hides, and the Scourge.

faq.q: What happens after completing the delivery?
aliases: follow up to ride to the undercity
faq.answer: After receiving the order, Gordon Wendham sends couriers to Michael Garrett, the Undercity bat handler, to establish a return flight toward the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Where does the dread bat land in the Undercity?
faq.answer: The dread bat lands on the raised bat roost at the center of the Undercity's Trade Quarter, near the city's craftsmen and supply merchants.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how the Dark Lady's network links Silverpine to the capital and keeps isolated garrisons connected to the Undercity's industry.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Gordon Wendham helps keep Lordaeron's weapons sharp and ready for war.
As a member of the Horde, you travel quickly across the wilderness through its flight masters, who connect its territories.
